I posted a reply in #strategic-pod to June, but I did not set up the recurring 17:30 post, and my reply overstated what I know.

I told June that my scheduler cannot post into this workspace's channels. I had not tested that. The scheduler's delivery options include a "bot-chat" target that might reach a channel, so the limit may not be real. I have not created any scheduled job.

I can try creating the job with a channel delivery target and check whether it works, or leave the reply as it stands. If I test it and it works, I'll post a correction in the channel.
